subject: Multi-carrier itinerary gap coverage — Novum onsite exec delegation
messages:
From: Novum Travel Ops <travelops@novum.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed multi-carrier itinerary for Novum onsite — needs gap coverage

Hi Maya,

Attached is a proposed itinerary for the Novum executive delegation (K. Iyer, L. Bennett, P. Reyes). Because of limited seats on direct carriers for the requested times, the quote contains split tickets — an international long-haul on UA138 (YVR->SFO) followed by a domestic segment on Alaska/DL to the final regional airport. That creates a 3h15m ground gap between PNRs.

Key points: 
- Total delta vs. straight-through fares: +$240 per traveler (split ticket administrative fee included).
- We can hold the itinerary until EOD Friday (2026-11-06 17:00 PST).
- Seats on the long-haul are confirmed, domestic seats are on request pending ticketing.
- We recommend purchasing the added buffer protection (rebooking waiver) for $45 per pax to cover missed connections across carriers.

Please see the attached "proposed-itin-novum.pdf" for full routing, approximate times, and seat maps. Questions: are the execs comfortable with a split-ticket gap that requires ground transfer (no through-checked bags), or should we push to rebook on a later single-carrier option with longer overall travel time?

If split-ticket is acceptable we'll: 1) add the rebooking waiver; 2) request seat confirmations for Karthik (window), Laura (aisle); 3) hold for approval.

Thanks,
Tara Nguyen
Novum Travel Ops
[Attachment: proposed-itin-novum.pdf (PDF, 270KB)]

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Novum Travel Ops <travelops@novum.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed multi-carrier itinerary for Novum onsite — needs gap coverage

Thanks Tara — quick clarification and a few preferences from our side.

1) Gap length: 3h15m is a bit long for our execs. Is there a later domestic leg that shortens the ground gap to <=1h45m while keeping cost delta < $350 per pax?
2) Baggage: can you confirm whether through-checked baggage is possible across the two PNRs? Our policy prefers not to have execs carry-on multiple bags.
3) Seats: please prioritize (in order) Karthik=window, Laura=aisle, Paul=bulkhead (if available).
4) Waiver: we are OK with the $45 rebooking waiver only if it covers a same-day rebook to earliest next flight on partner carriers; please confirm terms.

If the shorter-gap option increases cost >$350 per pax, hold the split-ticket and proceed with rebooking waiver + seat requests. Dev, can you confirm approval for up to $350 per pax?

Apologies for the moa of detail — Novum prefers minimal down-time and predictable arrival windows for the afternoon briefing.

Thanks,
Maya
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Maya / team — booking confirmed per approvals. Summary below and attachments attached: PNRs are split across two carriers; baggage will not be through-checked (per carriers' interline rules) — we arranged a porter at SFO to assist transfers and pre-tagged carry items.

Itinerary summary (abbreviated):
- PNR A (UA): YVR -> SFO UA138, dep 06:05, arr 08:12 (long-haul)
- Ground transfer (pre-arranged porter + 45-min buffer on motorcade)
- PNR B (DL via partner): SFO -> OAK (regional) DL4721, dep 11:30, arr 12:05

Ticketing: partially redacted ticket numbers attached in "pnr-confirmation-REDACTED.txt". We added the $45 per pax rebooking waiver (same-day rebook to earliest partner flt) as requested. Total incremental cost: $318 per pax.

Seat assignments: Karthik=12A (window), Laura=14C (aisle), Paul=8A (bulkhead) — seat maps attached.

Attachments: pnr-confirmation-REDACTED.txt (e-ticket stubs), backup-legs.xlsx (alternative routings held until 2026-11-06 17:00 PST).

Ground & arrival: motorcade scheduled to pick up at SFO International Arrivals at 12:30 (driver Paul G.). Hotel check-in arranged for 13:30. We will text the group on the day with PNR references and driver contact.

Please confirm receipt and we'll finalize a calendar update with the travel legs attached.

Safe travels,
Tara Nguyen
Novum Travel Ops
